sections.title: 1. Who's responsible for your data
sections.body: Muskl is an independently developed and operated project. For any question, contact mustafaliiyilmaz@gmail.com.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
sections.body:
• Account: email and password (managed by Supabase Auth, never stored in plain text)
• Profile: username, profile photo (optional)
• Body stats (optional): height, weight history
• Workouts: name, date, exercises, sets (reps, weight, RPE)
• Reports: which workout, by whom

sections.title: 3. Visibility of your data
sections.body: Muskl is a social app: your username, photo, and workouts are visible to everyone in the feed by default. Your height and weight history have a separate privacy setting (Profile tab → "Public profile"), on by default — you can turn it off at any time.

sections.title: 4. Data processor
sections.body: Data is hosted with Supabase (database, authentication, photo storage), in the European Union. No data is sold or shared for advertising purposes — Muskl shows no ads and uses no third-party analytics tools.

sections.title: 5. Retention period
sections.body: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. Deleting your account erases everything permanently.

sections.title: 6. Deleting your account
sections.body: Profile tab → Delete my account. Irreversible action: immediately deletes your account, profile, photo, workouts, exercises, sets, weight history, and reports.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: Under GDPR: access, rectification, erasure, portability. Most of these are available directly in the app. For any other request, contact us.

sections.title: 8. Reporting content
sections.body: You can report a workout from the feed. Reports are visible only to you and the Muskl team.

sections.title: 9. Security
sections.body: Data access is protected by row-level security rules in the database (Row Level Security). Traffic is encrypted (HTTPS).

sections.title: 10. Minimum age
sections.body: Muskl is not intended for people under 16.
